description: A bot fighting rats sets its drones on the one it locked, and the order is confirmed. A bot of one 'fight the rats' step is pasted into the Bot Builder and saved; the pilot undocks, leaves the station's grid, and rats are spawned on it; the bot runs in the page. The server sends the drones' new target with its next tick, after CmdEngage has answered, so a page that reads the drones only once straight after the order finds them not yet on it and pauses the run as unconfirmed (issue 177).

setup.note: the held session: never a pilot the web client flies
drone recovery checks a pilot that has just signed in
